newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai police seize 2.5 kg of heroin.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai police seize 2.5 kg of heroin.

text.p: Shanghai police have seized 2.53 kilograms of heroin and arrested seven people in a major drug bust, local television reported on Thursday.
The police said the seven had brought 5.5 kg of heroin into the city and already sold most of it for 300,000 yuan ($36,150), it said. It gave no further details.
China's official media is carrying increasing numbers of reports about illegal drug smuggling and consumption, particularly in urban areas.
